note: A leg may only report not_run when it is registered here AND the recomputed unavailability codes it names still hold on the committed graph. The set of codes is compared both ways: a code the gate computes but does not register, or a registered code that is no longer true, makes the leg run instead. review_by is an expiry: scripts/verify-ci-leg-receipts.mjs fails once it has passed.

entries.trigger: an index published in the retired 1.0.0 metadata schema (technical_status + download) is committed for the leg to audit; the @aikdna/kdna-cli pin is only required to be a checkable coordinate (exact SemVer or integrity-locked file: pin), so it no longer holds this leg at not_run

an index published in the retired 1.0.0 metadata schema (technical_status + download) is committed for the leg to compare against the online releases; the @aikdna/kdna-cli pin is only required to be a checkable coordinate, so it no longer holds this leg at not_run
the leg runs whenever it is registered; with an empty public index it audits zero entries and reports no unavailability, and it cannot report not_run again until a public asset is indexed
